heading: **9 February 2025**
date_note: Heading says **9 February 2025**; year assumed to be a typo (placed chronologically).
body:
*HTFS ligation size confirmation*

Run the following samples on a 0.5 % agarose gel:

1. Extend 1 kb ladder  
2. 1 kb plus ladder  
3. 147HTFSlig (2 uL)  
4. N40HTFSlig (1 uL)

From the agarose gels, it is seen that there is a smear of HMW but most of the DNA is spread around either the wells and some DNA is spread between 1-5 kb. 

4 uL of each sample was then used to set up another ligation O/N.

*ELF2lig native gel re-run*

Run the samples in an 8% TBE gel. Use 1 X TBE Running Buffer.

Pre-run empty gel at 100 V, 10 mins (cold room).

Run actual gel at 90 V, 90 mins.

Load samples along with Tridye ladder as well as 50-bp ladder and samples to be prepared in 10 uL with TBE Hi-Density Sample Buffer (2.5 uL per 10 uL sample).

Loading Order:

1. Tridye ladder  
2. 50-bp ladder  
3. ELFlig1  
4. ELFlig1 (EcoRV)  
5. ELFlig1 \+ nucleosome (EcoRV)  
6. ELFlig1 \+ ELF2 (EcoRV)  
7. ELFlig1 \+ nucleosome \+ ELF2 (EcoRV)  
8. 50-bp ladder  
9. Tridye ladder  
10. Loading dye
title: HTFS ligation size confirmation
